essence: On wisdom rising natural, sky-going Śiva-state.

rasa.justification: Mantra as being (not doing), effort as instrument (not struggle), womb-dream as gestation (not confusion), natural rising as flight — quiescence in every member.

sections.BOUNDARY: No technique is given; mantra is being, not doing.
sections.EXPLANATION: Mind mantra (citta itself). Effort, accomplisher (dynamic, not strained). Wisdom-body-being, mantra-secret (whose body is wisdom). In womb, mind-unfolding, indistinct-wisdom-dream (gestation, not confusion). On wisdom rising natural, sky-going Śiva-state (effortless flight).
sections.FUNCTION: States the śākta turn: mantra is mind, effort accomplishes, wisdom bodies, womb gestates, rising flies.
sections.KEY TERMS: citta-mantra (mind-mantra — awareness-state, not formula); prayatna (effort — dynamic); vidyā-śarīra (wisdom-body); garbha (womb — gestation); khecarī (sky-going).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Mantra-as-being here becomes guru, mātṛkā, oblation, food beyond.
sections.SUMMARY: Mind mantra. Effort, accomplisher. Wisdom-body-being, mantra-secret. In womb, mind-unfolding, indistinct-wisdom-dream. On wisdom rising natural, sky-going Śiva-state.
